rv.q: The musical performances are worth the price of admission, but they are deserving of a more robust story to thread them together.
The care given to every element creates a well-rounded production that is as uplifting as it is impressive.
Above all else, this show has an abundance of love, from the writing to the hair design by Sheena Marie Beauty.
This energetic, light, entertaining production will make audiences Stand Up and cheer.
I recommend The Salon with the caveat that you do not expect a backstory or depth to the characters.
As a result, the entire production came across as losing its sense of direction and badly written.
I highly recommend this production for a fun-filled afternoon or evening date night.
Yet you should go and see this production if only to listen to all of those glorious voices singing all sorts of fabulous songs.

cn.t: Critics find this jukebox musical about a Black hair salon entertaining with strong vocals and cultural resonance, though some fault its execution. Praised for tackling LGBTQ+ themes and celebrating African American culture.
